subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Yellowstone is a national park located primarily in Wyoming, United States.
• National parks are protected areas managed by the federal government to preserve natural resources.
• One feature they protect is wildlife habitat.
• Yellowstone covers an area of roughly 8,991 km².
• The United States has 63 designated national parks.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the size of Yellowstone. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Protecting wildlife habitat is just one example of how national parks preserve natural resources.
choices.B: The national park Yellowstone, located primarily in Wyoming, covers an area of roughly 8,991 km².
choices.C: Yellowstone is one of 63 protected areas, known as national parks, across the United States.
choices.D: Yellowstone—a protected area located primarily in Wyoming—preserves many natural resources for future generations.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes the size of Yellowstone, noting that it covers an area of roughly 8,991 km².
